Description: This workout has five rounds that include jabs, crosses, and front kicks. There are also burpees, pushups, and situps.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Reverse lunge with jab in guard (jab and step back same side, alternating) • Jumping jacks • Sumo squat to single arm circle and elbows up twist and rotate torso (alternating sides/arms)

Round 1 • Punches • Front jab, cross, lean back, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Front kick, rear block, hip switch progression (stationary, hip switch and reset, hip switch squat and reset)

Round 3 • Combo • Jab, cross, lean back, cross, front kick, rear block, hip switch progression (stationary, hip switch and reset, hip switch squat and reset)

Round 4 • Conditioning

1. Chest-to-ground burpees
2. Push-ups
3. Sit-up with diagonal punches (punch once each side, then roll down to reset)

Round 5 • Combo • Same as Round 3

Final Round • Jab, cross, chest-to-ground burpee, switch sides (alternating)

Cooldown • Interlace hands and round back (back opener) to chest T-opener

Description: This workout has two three-minute rounds, plus a final round that lasts one minute. Some of the moves are jabs, crosses, knee strikes, and burpees.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Squat to chest T-opener • Power jacks (punch overhead) • Reverse lunge with rotation (elbows high, hands stacked, alternating)

Round 1 • Front jab, cross, roll (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Rear knee, front push kick, squat progression (double pulse squat, double pulse reach down squat, squat to burpee)

Final Round • Jab, cross, roll, rear knee, push kick, squat to burpee (30 sec each side)

Cooldown • Shoulder rolls back

Description: This workout has seven three-minute rounds that include roundhouse kicks, lunges, and punch combinations. There is also a final round that lasts one minute with side shuffles and punches.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Supported reverse lunge with single arm circle back (alternating) • Side shuffle with arm swings back • Supported squat with rotation (elbowing back, alternating)

Round 1 • Front knee, rear push kick, sidestep progression (small sidestep, bigger sidestep, sidstep with jump)

Round 2 • Double jab, cross elbow (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Icky shuffle
2. Pushup to Beast
3. Strider, strider, jump lunge

Round 4 • Step diagonal to roundhouse kick, squat progression (land and reset, squat and reset, jump-switch to reset)

Round 5 • Lead jab, cross, up elbow (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 6 • Conditioning • Same as Round 3

Round 7 • Jab, cross, up elbow, step diagonal, roundhouse kick, squat progression (land and reset, squat and reset, jump-switch to reset)

Final Round • Icky shuffle punches

Cooldown • Step back elbows high with rotation (alternating), hamstring scoops, small hinge to arm circles back

Description: This workout has five three-minute rounds that include punches, knee strikes, and kicks. You’ll also do squats, skaters, and lunges. There is also a final round that lasts one minute.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Step back with side bend (alternating), Jump rope • Lateral lunge in guard (alternating)

Round 1 • Jab, lead uppercut, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Rear knee, rear knee, rear push kick, squat progression (small squat, full squat, squat jump)

Round 3 • Combo • Jab, uppercut, cross, 2 rear knees, rear push kick, squat progression (small squat, full squat, squat jump)

Round 4 • Conditioning

1. Pop lunges
2. Push-up, one shoulder tap (alternating taps every push-up)
3. Skaters

Round 5 • Same as Round 3

Final Round • Skate and punch (skater with punch, using inside arm)

Cooldown • Shoulder rolls back

Description: This workout has three rounds. The moves include punches, front kicks, and squat jumps. The final round features all the moves combined for one minute of all-out intensity.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Supported squat to standing hip circle (out, alternating) • Jump rope side to side • Rolling in guard side to side then add a punch (alternating arms, punching with arm rolling towards)

Round 1 • Jab, cross, front hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Rear knee, rear front kick, squat progression (reset, squat, squat jump)

Final Round • Combo • Jab, cross, front hook, rear knee, rear front kick, squat jump to other side (alternating)

Cooldown • Pivoting arm swings

Description: This workout has seven rounds that last three minutes each, plus a final round that lasts one minute. Some of the moves are jabs, crosses, squats, and planks.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Squat to hip circle/opener (alternating circles after each squat) • Fast feet (open wide on coach call) • Lateral lunge with ankle tap (alternating sides) • Repeat moves

Round 1 • Rear cross block, lead push kick, squat progression (squat, heel click pop squat, squat jump)

Round 2 • Jab, cross body shot, lead hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Side shuffle reach down (inside of ankle, alternating)
2. Plank row (alternating arms)
3. Broad jump forward, shuffle back

Round 4 • Combo • Jab, cross body shot, lead hook, rear cross block, lead push kick, squat progression (squat, heel click pop squat, squat jump)

Round 5 • Conditioning • Same as Round 3

Round 6 • Same as round 2

Round 7 • Same as round 1

Final Round • Side shuffle with side body shot (kind of like an uppercut to the side)

Cooldown • Side step • Small reverse lunge with reach overhead to stretch hips (alternating sides)

Description: This workout features five three-minute rounds that include punches and kicks at different heights. There is also a final one-minute round of squat jumps and jabs.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Bum kick each side rotate/twist elbows high each side then reset, Junp rope • Hamstring scoop to Y overhead (alternating legs)

Round 1 • Jab, back uppercut, lead hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Rear push kick low, rear push kick high, squat progression (pause/reset, squat, squat heel click)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Hurdle to jump and overhead reach
2. High-to-low plank
3. Striders

Round 4 • Low side kick, high side kick, squat progression (pause/reset, squat, squat heel click)

Round 5 • Jab, pull back, lead hook, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Final Round • Squat jump with jab to heel click (30 sec facing each side on diagonal)

Cooldown • Shoulder rolls back then forward

Description: This workout has two three-minute rounds, plus a final round that lasts one minute. Round one includes hooks. Round two has push-kicks. In the final round, you will combine the moves.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Supported squat to elbows high rotation (alternating sides) • Fast feet • Alternating reverse lunge with double punch overhead

Round 1 • Lead hook, cross, lead hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Lead push kick, rear push kick, bouncing progression (double bounce, strider/switch, faster switch)

Final Round • Combo • Lead hook, cross, lead hook, lead push kick, rear push kick, strider/switch

Cooldown • Side step with swinging chest openers • Reach overhead to hinge swinging hug

Description: This workout has seven rounds that last three minutes each, plus a one-minute final round. Across the first seven rounds, you’ll do upper cuts, hooks, kicks, skaters, and pushups. The final round features squats and kicks.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Supported sumo squat to side bend with reach (alternating reach after each squat) • High knees • Supported hinge to elbows high twist/rotation (alternating twist after each hinge) • Repeat moves

Round 1 • Lead uppercut, rear uppercut, lead hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Step back, side kick, reset progression (step forward, jump forward, tuck jump and reset)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Skaters with chop downs
2. Plank walkout to 2 push-ups, walk back and roll up
3. Squat jumps forward and back with push/pull bar (double punch, like holding a pole)

Round 4 • Roll, each side, front hook, rear hook (easy, bounce , hard)

Round 5 • Rear push kick, hitch kick progression (step forward knee up, small hitch knee/jumping knee, full hitch knee with bigger jump)

Round 6 • Conditioning • Same as Round 3

Round 7 • Combo • Lead uppercut, rear uppercut, rear push kick, hitch knee progression (step forward knee up, small hitch knee, full hitch knee)

Final Round • 2 squat jumps forward with bar push/pull to push kick each leg

Cooldown • Supported hinge to shoulder rolls back to crossbody shoulder stretch each arm

Description: This workout has two rounds that last three minutes each, plus a final round that lasts one minute. In the first round, you’ll do jabs. The second round is focused on knee strikes. The final round combines the moves. The playlist features all women artists in honour of International Women’s Day.
Workout Details:
Round 1 • Triple jab (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • 3 knee strikes (squat step foot back to touch, squat pop, squat jump and reach)

Final Round • Triple jab, 3 knee strikes, squat jump reach and switch sides

Description: This workout has five rounds that last three minutes each, and a one-minute final round. Some of the moves are uppercuts, kicks, and variations of squats. In celebration of International Women’s Day, the playlist features all women artists.
Workout Details:
Round 1 • Punches • Front jab, turn, lead hook, turn, lead uppercut (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Kicks • Rear low kick, rear push kick (squat, squat punch up on toes, squat jump punch up)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Plank walkout to push-up and reach arms up on reset
2. V-sit with diagonal punches
3. Grab knees (alternating)

Round 4 • Combo • Front jab, turn, lead hook, turn, lead uppercut, step, turn, rear low kick, rear push kick (squat, squat punch up on toes, squat jump punch up)

Round 5 • Conditioning • Same as Round 3

Final Round • Lead hook, rear push kick, squat jump punch up (switch sides halfway through)

Description: This workout has two rounds that last three minutes each, plus a final round that lasts one minute at an all-out intensity. The moves include jabs, lunge jumps, and knee strikes.
Workout Details:
Round 1 •  Jab, cross, hook, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • 2 knee strikes (lunge down, small lunge jump, lunge jump)

Final Round • Jab, cross, hook, cross, 2 knee strikes, lunge jump

Description: This workout has seven rounds that last three minutes each, plus a one-minute final round. Some of the moves are side kicks, jumping jacks, and punches.
Workout Details:
Round 1 • Punches • Hook, roll, hook

Round 2 • Kicks • Roundhouse kick, side kick (tap back twice, two bounces back, jump to reset)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Jumping jack to air jack
2. Sprinter sit-ups
3. Lateral jump to pike

Round 4 • Punches • Superman punch (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 5 • Kicks • Front push kick, back push kick (battle rope double bounce, double jump, jump slam)

Round 6 • Conditioning • Same as Round 3

Round 7 • Combo • Superman punch, front push kick, rear push kick (battle rope double bounce, double jump, jump slam)

Final Round • Superman punch to pike (each side ~30 sec)

Description: This workout has seven rounds that last three minutes each. Some of the moves are jabs, kicks, knee strikes, and mountain climbers. There is also a one-minute final round that includes jumps and burpees.
Workout Details:
Round 1 • Double jab (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Lead push kick, jump progression (lead knee up, small gallop, jump), rear push kick

Round 3 • Combo • Double jab, lead push kick, jump progression (lead knee up, small gallop, jump), rear push kick

Round 4 • Conditioning

1. Hands behind head, forward lunge, alternating leges
2. Slow crossbody mountain climbers
3. Lateral jump to burpee

Round 5 • Combo • Round 3 combo + lead cross block

Round 6 • Conditioning • Same as Round 4

Round 7 • Combo • Round 5 + cross

Final Round • Lateral jump, cross block, burpee, alternating sides

Description: This workout has five rounds that last three minutes each, plus a final round that lasts one minute. There are two rounds of punches with hooks and two rounds of kicks with hooks. In the final round, you will combine the moves.
Workout Details:
Round 1 • Rear uppercut, hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Hook, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. Jump lunge with diagonal chop
2. High plank hold
3. Icky shuffle

Round 4 • Front block, step in, hook kick, leap progression (small side step to reset, leap, leap and reach down like a skater)

Round 5 • Step in, hook kick, step back to low kick, squat progression (small squat, small squat jump, squat jump and reach)

Final Round • Step in, hook kick, front hook, 180 jump to other side)

Description: This workout has two rounds that last three minutes each, with a focus on punches and front kicks. There is also a one-minute final round that combines the moves.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Supported sumo squat to goal post arms and pivot/turn, reset (alternating) • Jumping jacks

Round 1 • Cross, hold, jab, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Front push kick, knee progression (step forward rear high knee, reach down knee drive, reach ground knee drive hop)

Final Round • Combo • Cross, hold, jab, cross, front push kick, reach ground knee drive hop (30 sec each side)

Cooldown • Shoulder shrugs • Pivoting swings side-to-side

Description: This workout has five rounds that last three minutes each, plus a one-minute final round. Some of the moves are jabs, knee strikes, push kicks, and a variation of pushups.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Squat to standing hip opener/rotation/circle (alternating) • Jump rope • Step back and rotate with hands stacked/elbows high (alternating sides)

Round 1 • Jab, cross, slip, cross (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Rear knee, lead push kick, leap forward and back progression (step, small jump, squat jump)

Round 3 • Combo • Jab, cross, slip, cross, rear knee, lead push kick, leap forward and back progression (step, small jump, squat jump)

Round 4 • Conditioning • Alternating moves about 20-25 sec each

1. Burpee to pushup (not as fast)
2. High knees and straight punches

Round 5 • Combo • Same as Round 3

Final Round • Burpee pushup to push kick (alternating legs on kick)

Cooldown • Diagonal chest openers (alternating)

Description: This workout has two rounds that last three minutes each, plus a final round that lasts one minute. Round one has a focus on punches. Round two has a move called “switch knees.” Round three combines the moves.
Workout Details:
Warmup • In guard, roll side to side • Jump rope • Reverse diagonal lunge to chest T-opener (alternating) 

Round 1 • Jab, cross, jab, cross, hook (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Jump and switch, rear knee (1, 2, then 3 knees), step back

Final Round • Combo • Jab, cross, jab, cross, lead hook, switch, 3 knees (30 sec each side)

Cooldown • Step side to side, swinging easy chest openers

Description: This workout has five rounds that last three minutes each. Some of the moves are side kicks with burpees, pushups, and uppercuts. There is also a one-minute final round that combines kicks and punches.
Workout Details:
Warmup • Sumo squat shoulder dips (both sides, reset) • High knee skip (push interlaced hands down into lifted knee, alternating) • Reverse lunge to Y overhead (alternating sides)

Round 1 • Low kick, front push kick, jump back progression (step back then forward, jump back then jump forward,  jump back touch down pop squat then jump forward)

Round 2 • Side kick, squat progression (squat touchdown, burpee, burpee to overhead jump and reach)

Round 3 • Conditioning

1. 2 striders, jump slam switch/strider on reset
2. Plank walkout to push-up to shoulder tap each arm, reset
3. 3 lateral jumps to reach down (pop squat)

Round 4 • Jab, step forward horizontal elbow strike (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 5 • Front jab, leanback, rear uppercut (easy, bound, hard)

Final Round • Jab, step forward, horizontal elbow, step back, 2 striders, jump slam switch/strider

Cooldown • Crossbody shoulder stretch and twist/rotate

Warmup • Squat in guard to pivoting punch (alternating) • Jumping jacks • Diagonal hamstring scoops (alternating)

Round 1 • Jab, cross, dip down, rear uppercut (easy, bounce, hard)

Round 2 • Feint, front knee, rear push kick progression (pause, small gallop, full jumping push kick)

Round 3 • Combo • Jab cross, dip, rear uppercut, feint, front knee, rear push kick progression (pause, small gallop, full jumping push kick)

Round 4 • Conditioning

1. Lateral lunge with double punch to overhead punch jump (alternating sides)
2. Elbow plank saw (pushing on toes going forward and back)
3. Speed squats

Round 5 • Combo • Repeat Round 3

Final Round • Lateral lunge with double punch to jumping push kick (kick opposite side of lunge, alternating sides)

Cooldown • Pivoting arm swings
